title: Marketplace onboarding: dashboards + alerts for entitlement lag, webhook errors, provisioning failures
author: Allison Grant
release_notes:
- Added Grafana dashboard for marketplace purchase→provisioning pipeline.
- Added alert rules for entitlement lag, webhook validation failures, and provisioning error rate.
- Added runbook links and annotation conventions for incident triage.
description:
Summary: Adds a first-pass observability bundle for the cloud marketplace onboarding pipeline (AWS + GCP) covering the failure modes we’ve seen during review/testing: (1) entitlement activation delays, (2) webhook ingestion/validation errors, and (3) downstream provisioning failures (org-linking + entitlement mapping).

Motivation: We’re rolling out new marketplace SKUs and a revamped purchase→provisioning flow. Current telemetry exists in app logs and scattered metrics, but we don’t have a single dashboard to answer “is onboarding healthy right now?” nor alerting tied to buyer-visible impact. This PR introduces a standard dashboard + alert set to support launch readiness and ongoing ops.

What’s included (Dashboards): 1) Dashboard: "Marketplace Onboarding / Provisioning Health" (folder: GTM / Marketplace). Key sections/panels: - Topline: webhook events received/s, success rate, and end-to-end provisioning success. - Entitlement lag: time between marketplace purchase entitlement event and Redwood entitlement activation (p50/p95/p99) and a histogram by provider (aws|gcp) and region. - Webhook validation: invalid signature / schema / replay detection counters, plus 4xx vs 5xx breakdowns. - Provisioning failures: error rate and top error reasons (region mismatch, org-linking conflict, missing entitlement mapping) derived from standardized error code labels. - SLO guardrails: buyer-facing "time to activation" with a suggested threshold line and annotations for deploys.

What’s included (Alerts): Alert rules are scoped to buyer impact and tuned to avoid paging for background noise. - EntitlementLagP95High: p95 entitlement lag > 300s for 15m (page). - EntitlementLagP99Critical: p99 entitlement lag > 900s for 10m (page). - WebhookValidationFailuresSpike: validation failures > 5/min for 10m (page) with provider label; intended to catch signature/secret drift or partner-side format change. - WebhookIngestion5xxRate: 5xx rate > 1% of webhook requests for 10m (page). - ProvisioningFailureRateHigh: provisioning failures > 2% of attempts for 15m (page). - ProvisioningQueueBacklog: backlog > 1000 or oldest item age > 10m for 10m (ticket) (only if the queue metrics exist; rule is guarded by “present()” checks to avoid firing in environments where the queue is disabled).

Runbooks: Added runbook links into alert annotations (internal). Runbooks cover immediate actions: verify partner webhook delivery status, check entitlement mapping tables, retry/backfill job, and the common region-mismatch remediation.

Metric conventions (assumed/required): This PR assumes the application pipeline emits the following (or equivalents already present in prod): - marketplace_webhook_requests_total{provider, status_code} - marketplace_webhook_validation_failures_total{provider, reason} - marketplace_entitlement_activation_lag_seconds{provider, region} (histogram) - marketplace_provisioning_attempts_total{provider} - marketplace_provisioning_failures_total{provider, error_code} - marketplace_provisioning_queue_depth (gauge) and marketplace_provisioning_queue_oldest_age_seconds (gauge)

Notes / follow-ups: - If/when we add a distinct "org linking completed" metric, we should split time-to-activation into (purchase→entitlement) and (entitlement→org-link) to localize lag. - Thresholds are conservative for launch; we should revisit after 2–3 weeks of real traffic. - This PR includes a small amount of label normalization in dashboard queries to handle old “cloud_provider” vs new “provider” label keys.

Testing: - `make validate` (jsonnet render + grafana dashboard schema checks) - `make test-alerts` (promtool rules check) - Smoke rendered dashboards in dev Grafana (screenshot links in comments).

notable_snippets:
Prometheus alert (excerpt):
- alert: MarketplaceEntitlementLagP95High
  expr: |
    histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider) (rate(marketplace_entitlement_activation_lag_seconds_bucket[10m]))) > 300
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Marketplace entitlement lag p95 high ({{ $labels.provider }})"
    runbook_url: "https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/runbooks/marketplace/onboarding#entitlement-lag"

Grafana query (excerpt):
(sum(rate(marketplace_webhook_requests_total{status_code=~"2.."}[5m])) by (provider))
/
(sum(rate(marketplace_webhook_requests_total[5m])) by (provider))
review_conversation:
Rafael Mendes (SRE lead): Can we avoid paging on backlog for environments where queue metrics don’t exist? Also please add a clear signal for partner-side failures vs our 5xx.

Allison Grant (author): Good call. Updated backlog rule to guard with `present(marketplace_provisioning_queue_depth)` and moved it to ticket severity. Added a separate alert for webhook 5xx rate with status_code label and left validation failures as page since that’s typically secret/signature drift.

Ethan Park (Eng lead, entitlement mapping): For provisioning failure codes, do we have stable `error_code` values across AWS and GCP? We’ve historically used free-form strings.

Allison Grant: Dashboard is tolerant (topk by error_code), but alerts depend on aggregate failure rate only (no per-code paging). I added a note in the runbook + dashboard panel description that error_code should be from the canonical enum set (region_mismatch, org_conflict, mapping_missing, unknown). This matches what ENG-4401/4402 are implementing.

Chloe Martin (Console backend): Could we add an annotation line for deploys to correlate spikes? I don’t want folks guessing whether it’s a release.

Allison Grant: Added support for deploy annotations via `deploy_events_total` if present; otherwise it renders as empty. Also added a static instruction in the dashboard header to use the “Console Deploys” annotation source.

Leila Farouk (QA automation): Can we include a panel that’s easy to screenshot for launch readiness (one graph that shows green/red)?

Allison Grant: Added a single-stat row: webhook success %, provisioning success %, entitlement lag p95, all with thresholds and color mapping.

Rafael Mendes: LGTM after promtool passes.

CI rerun after fixing YAML indentation passed; approved.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Connor O'Brien (release engineering). Squash commit message: "Marketplace onboarding observability (dashboards + alerts)"
